THE ONLY PLACE MY KIDS STOPPED COMPLAINING

We came here after a boat trip and honestly everyone was a bit grumpy, especially the kids. It was one of those hot days at the end of June when even walking 5 minutes feels long.
The honey ribs saved the day. My son finished his portion and even asked for more rice, which almost never happens when we travel.

Not the fanciest meal of our trip, but probably one of the easiest and most relaxed.
